package logsagent

import (
	"context"
	"strconv"
	"time"

	"go.opentelemetry.io/collector/pdata/plog"
)

func (c *Delivery) ConsumeLogs(ctx context.Context, data plog.Logs) error {
	if !FaultEnabled("admission") {
		return c.consumeLogs(ctx, data)
	}
	done := make(chan error, c.cfg.MaxConcurrentCalls)
	for i := range c.cfg.MaxConcurrentCalls {
		copyData := plog.NewLogs()
		data.CopyTo(copyData)
		for _, rl := range copyData.ResourceLogs().All() {
			for _, sl := range rl.ScopeLogs().All() {
				for _, record := range sl.LogRecords().All() {
					record.Body().SetStr(record.Body().Str() + " injected-call=" + strconv.Itoa(i))
				}
			}
		}
		go func() { done <- c.consumeLogs(ctx, copyData) }()
	}
	timeout := time.NewTimer(5 * time.Second)
	defer timeout.Stop()
	for c.account.Snapshot().Outstanding != int64(c.cfg.MaxConcurrentCalls) {
		select {
		case <-timeout.C:
			panic("fault fixture did not fill delivery admission")
		default:
			time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
		}
	}
	FaultMark("admission_full")
	err := c.consumeLogs(ctx, data)
	if err == nil || err.Error() != "logs route pre-export rejection: admission_saturated" {
		panic("excess call did not return an admission rejection")
	}
	FaultMark("admission_rejected")
	for range c.cfg.MaxConcurrentCalls {
		if callErr := <-done; callErr != nil {
			panic(callErr)
		}
	}
	return err
}
